author: Good Enough
description:
Spies used hidden weapons like the glove gun, devices designed to fire a single shot on impact during close combat.

Developed during the Cold War, the glove gun was built to be concealed in plain sight, turning a simple punch into a deadly attack. Compact and unusual, it shows how far espionage technology went in creating weapons that could be used without warning.

This Short explores one of the most unexpected spy weapons ever created and how it was meant to work.
